text: I'm a childminder, one of my little ones is staying late tonight, boy aged 2, and his temp just read 40. FORTY. I've given him calpol and honestly in between doses he's playing with the trains and drinking his milk and babbling away like nothing's wrong but that number has really scared me, I've never seen it that high on any of the kids. His dad's on the way but it's another hour. I keep checking it
